item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a strong 2024 example of Jokowi personally declaring or using formal emergency powers in a way comparable to a nationwide emergency decree. I also did not find a clear 2024 anti-terror campaign that was central to this lens. The strongest evidence is instead about digital/content control, protest policing, and technical-security regulation, with the negative side concentrated in Papua and election-related protest management.","evidence":[{"title":"Indonesia president orders audit of data centres after cyberattack","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-06-28","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Indonesia-president-orders-audit-of-data-centres-after-cyberattack-47264139/","summary":"After a ransomware attack disrupted public services, Jokowi ordered an audit of government data centres rather than using the incident for mass punishment.
